Integrate CodeOn notification router and workers (#211)

    ## Summary
    
    - add strict disabled-by-default notification routes and Webhook destination configuration
    - compose transactional PostgreSQL routing, LISTEN wake hints with polling recovery, and bounded shared delivery workers into daemon readiness and shutdown
    - document runtime configuration and add focused startup-validation coverage
